name: flux-reader-monorepo
description: Flux Reader 多平台 Markdown 阅读器 monorepo

scripts.install:all: npm run install:fnos && npm run install:reader
scripts.test: npm run test:release && npm run test:fnos && npm run test:reader
scripts.lint:macos: xcrun swift-format lint --strict --recursive apps/macos/FluxReader apps/macos/FluxReaderTests apps/macos/FluxReaderUITests
scripts.test:macos: npm --prefix packages/reader-web run build:contract:macos && xcodebuild -project apps/macos/FluxReader.xcodeproj -scheme FluxReader -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath .build/macos CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO -only-testing:FluxReaderTests test
scripts.test:macos-ui-build: xcodebuild -project apps/macos/FluxReader.xcodeproj -scheme FluxReaderUITests -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath .build/macos-ui-build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build-for-testing
scripts.test:macos-ui: xcodebuild -project apps/macos/FluxReader.xcodeproj -scheme FluxReaderUITests -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath .build/macos-ui-runtime CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- CODE_SIGN_STYLE=Manual test
scripts.test:all: npm run version:check && npm test && npm run test:render-contract && npm run test:macos
scripts.build:macos: xcodebuild -project apps/macos/FluxReader.xcodeproj -scheme FluxReader -configuration Debug -destination 'platform=macOS' -derivedDataPath .build/macos CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.pack:fnos: npm run build:fnos && cd apps/fnos/package && fnpack build
